notes.notes:
The time is upon us. If nothing major comes up, this is the build that will be released May 12 : )

Changelog
- Handling of a couple of rare exceptions.

notes.title: 🎯 Release Date + Patch Notes (v0.14.2)
notes.notes:
[h3]🎯 Release Date [/h3]

Ahh it's been such a cold, dark journey in the depths of Deus Proxima Labs. Listening to the every sound countless times, getting lost on purpose stress testing the level design, shivering when things *clicked* and wanting to shift delete the whole project when things didn't... (ok I'm only 10% serious about that last one).

[url=Steam :: https://https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694670/][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/k7Vy81QMRxgE31x5dy/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Thursday May 12th[/b], Apotheorasis will "see the light of day" so to speak 👁️

In the days leading up to that I'll be focusing my efforts on polishing how the page looks, reaching out to reviewers, curators etc and adding the game's Soundtrack as a package with high quality files, alt takes, and audio-visual material from the rehearsals.

- - - - - - - - - - - - -

[h3] v0.14.2 Changelog [/h3]
[list]
[*] Balanced the characters' volumes throughout the Prologue
[*] Improved timing of voice lines in intro and hospital cutscenes
[*] Added extra ambient SFX to help with navigation in the Cave
[/list]

notes.notes:
A few cool updates regarding final quality VOs

[*] Final quality song and accompaniment (piano) have been mastered

notes.title: 🎤 Voice Actors Added [update #03]
notes.notes:
[h3]🎤 Voice Actors Added[/h3]

It's the time we've all been waiting for. v0.14 brings with it full quality voice acting patched in.

My beautiful developer's voice can finally retire, as it's replaced by a fantastic cast of 5 voice actors who will breathe, speak, shout, whisper, whistle, hum and sing just for you!

Alongside this update, the price has been set to the intended launch price (50% up from Early Access).

PS: They are still non-mastered, so some of the volumes may be off, and it's possible in the 1,100 lines the project has that a handful are misplaced, wrongly trimmed etc  - let me know via [url=https://discord.com/invite/tallguyprods]Discord[/url] if you catch anything!

notes.title: v0.13 [update #02]
notes.notes:
[h3]👁️ Main Game Feature-Complete[/h3]

V0.13 brings kids, and dogs, and songs to the prologue, as we are recording the final Voice Actors. The main game is now feature-Complete ; all 3 Acts and Challenges (repeat playthroughs) are coded in.

[i]PS: If you find bugs, blame the version number (and let me know via [url=https://discord.gg/tallguyprods]Discord[/url])[/i]

[h3]🎤 Final Recording & Price Increase[/h3]

10/03 we're recording and a couple of days after we should have the final lines in the game. 

[i][b]NOTE :: At that point I'll be increasing the game's price to its full price (about 50% higher than Early Access), so now's your last chance to grab it at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694670]Early Access Price[/url] : )[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes (v0.12.2)
notes.notes:
System was so intent on vibrating something that wasn’t there, that, when it failed, anything following that failure was also doomed to fail, including setting up the menu, characters etc.

You were stuck with a really sad, non-vibrating system.

It’s now been convinced that the show must go on, even without vibrations!

[img]https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzgxODcwMzQucG5n/original/ARoCoJ.png[/img]

notes.title: v0.12 [update #01]
notes.notes:
[h3]💻 v0.12 changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial fight[/b] is easier ; less movement by the scientist, more forgiving aiming for the player.
[*] Besides footsteps, there's now [b][i]hand[/i]steps[/b], which should make navigating corridors easier.
[*] Added [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1694670/discussions/0/3178980819224074750/]mouse sensitivity[/url] hotkeys.
[*] NPCs can interrupt their own voices when they have something more important to say.
[*] Improved wall placement to help guide the player towards the intended goals.
[*] Under-the-hood improvements for even smaller patches (they usually are a few hundred KBs).
[*] Some logical errors that prevented you from answering during the menu have been fixed.[/list]

notes.title: 🎯 Early Access Released • 💻 Prologue Renovated
notes.notes:
[h3]💻 The Prologue got a fresh coat of paint[/h3]

Since Early Access just released, there's goodies for the Prologue too!

[list]
[*] [b][i]Vibrations yeee[/i][/b] I've added 50 or so unique vibration profiles for different events in the game. I feel they add a lot, maybe because losing sight makes all your other senses tingle.
[*] Movement, footsteps, calls (from the agent), SFX - all of the [b]core gameplay[/b] really - has been tweaked as much as humanly possible for now. Pretty happy with the result.
[*] Ironed out Shooting, Walking, Chasing, Navigation... all [b]gameplay segments[/b] , based on your feedback ❤️ (ie. the dreaded bridge / minefield segments are still challenging but should feel fairer)
[*] On that note, [b]load overrides[/b]! You can re-play the game from a specific point or the beginning (see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1836310/discussions/0/5116650215584525819/]discussion[/url] for more info)
[*] [b]Achievements[/b], achievements everywhere ! The full quality release will launch with 22 achievements and support...
[*] As promised, all [b]progress[/b] (including achievements) gets transferred seamlessly to the main game (any achievements you earn playing the Prologue or during Load overrides are awarded to Steam the next time you boot the full game normally)
[*] [b]Re-recorded[/b] all Menu lines (it's still me, but now there's a consistent tone / quality to them)
[/list]

[h3]🎯 Early Access (Acts 1 & 2) is Out[/h3]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694670][b]Early Access[/b][/url] version that just released, has all of the above plus the entirety of Act 2, where the story really kicks into high gear and the gameplay follows suit with stealth, ambushing, and survival vs multiple opponents... Shield & Shoot your way through about 40 more minutes of content 😄 

The price of Early Access will be about half of what the final quality release will cost, so if you're planning on getting the game it's as good a deal as they come
